# Cazarini Coffee Trading

> Coffee brokerage firm connecting Brazilian coffee producers, exporters, and global buyers since 2009. Based in Varginha, Minas Gerais — the heart of Brazil's largest coffee-producing region.

## Key Facts

- Founded in 2009 in Varginha, Minas Gerais, Brazil.
- Founder & Head Coffee Trader: Thiago Marques Cazarini, with 21+ years of experience in the Brazilian coffee market.
- 920+ bags of coffee delivered, 250+ trusted trading partners.
- Works directly with 250+ partner farms across Minas Gerais, with full lot traceability from farm to port.
- 98% client retention rate.
- Coffee qualities brokered: Fine Cup, Good Cup, Rio Minas, and Conilon (Robusta).
- Certifications available: RFA (Rainforest Alliance), 4C, EUDR compliance, Fair Trade, and Organic.
- Weekly market reports referenced by industry professionals worldwide.
- Bilingual operation: English and Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR).
- Languages of service and site content: English (en) and Portuguese (pt-BR).
